items.title: Pick Your Switcher
items.subtitle: Apollo's classic Favorites popup is back, or choose the Modern search sheet under Display & Navigation.

items.title: Jump to New Comments
items.subtitle: Set the jump button to step through comments posted since your last visit.

items.title: Tint Your Tab Bar
items.subtitle: Give tab icons, Liquid Glass buttons and unread badges your theme's accent, or shrink badges to a dot.

items.title: Hidden & Deleted, Native
items.subtitle: Hidden and deleted posts and comments now use Apollo's own lists, layouts and menus.

items.title: iPhone Duo, Smoother
items.subtitle: Swipes follow your finger, the split's divider drags, and Focused works in portrait.

items.title: American or British Spelling
items.subtitle: Reborn's screens now default to American spelling, with a setting to switch the whole app to British.

items.title: Fixes Across the App
items.subtitle: API-Key-Free feeds and More Replies load again, camera-roll GIFs post animated, and crashes are fixed.
